name: Wuhan Raycus Fiber Laser Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: Wuhan Raycus Fiber Laser Technologies Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, sale, and repair services of fiber lasers in China and internationally. It offers continuous, quasi-continuous, pulsed, and narrow linewidth fiber lasers, as well as direct semiconductor, ultra-fast, industrial, consumer, security, and medical lasers. The company is also involved in fiber optic manufacturing; software development; and housing rental. It exports its products. The company was founded in 2007 and is based in Wuhan, China.
